patthana23.50:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana23.50:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na mahāggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.50:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na parittārammaṇaṃ
